data.name: Luqman
data.gender_notes: Luqman is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name of the wise sage Luqmān, from the Arabic root ل-ق-م (l-q-m). Its root is ل-ق-م (l-q-m). Luqmān the Wise; Sūrat Luqmān in the Qur'an. Luqman is a Arabic name meaning “(A sage's name); wise”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Luqman expresses “(A sage's name); wise”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: The name of the wise sage Luqmān, from the Arabic root ل-ق-م (l-q-m).
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Luqman total 24, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
